name: Likwid
rootCause: missing pairDelta update in leverage=0 margin borrow freezes AMM quote. Lost: 74.31 BNB (reproduced to within 3 wei)

descriptions.text: missing pairDelta update in leverage=0 margin borrow freezes AMM quote. Lost: 74.31 BNB (reproduced to within 3 wei)

The BNB Chain DeFi protocol Likwid was exploited due to a margin-borrow contract bug. In the leverage=0 path of LikwidMarginPosition, pair reserves were not updated, so each borrow reused the same quote. The attacker first pumped a thin meme pool, then repeated the collateral/borrow cycle and drained 74.31 BNB (~$ 55,721) from the vault. The funds were later sent to Tornado Cash.
